name_input: EPIROC MINING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; Epiroc Mining India Private Limited; EPIROC MINING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; Epiroc Mining India PRIVATE Limited; EPIROC MINING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; EPIROC MINING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; EPIROC MINING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export record found. The only populated ImportKey record set (slug 'epiroc-mining-india-private-limited', counter: 'Total Shipments 115585 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 409', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28') shows India-bound INBOUND rows only, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-28 | EPIROC MINING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | EPIROC REGIONAL DC | Rock Roller Bits DTH Bits -QL,60,BIT 203MM CONVEX/CONCAVE S ( 60 NOS @1,025.26 CAD )- HYDERABAD ICD INSNF6, India | Montreal, Canada | 82071900 | 1143195" — i.e. supplier=Epiroc Regional DC, buyer=Epiroc Mining India, destination=India (import), HS 82071900, B/L 1143195. Rows actually seen: 5 of the claimed 115,585 (all imports, all HS 82071900, all dated 2026-02-28, all into Hyderabad ICD INSNF6). No outbound/export row with an Indian origin port and foreign destination was visible. Slug variants 'epiroc-mining-india-ltd' and 'epiroc-mining-india-pvt-ltd' returned zero records ('Loading...' / no table). volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused), so no second-source export confirmation was possible.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply evidence retrieved. thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India sales splits could not be read. Note: the ImportKey record set does show the entity is an active operating importer at Indian ports (Hyderabad ICD INSNF6, Nhava Sheva INNSA1, Sahar Air Cargo INBOM4, Delhi Air Cargo INDEL4 per 'Top Ports' block), which evidences inbound trade activity but is NOT evidence of domestic supply.
note: Declared HS codes 842121;842139;848110;848120 (valves/pumps, 'oil & gas and chemicals') do not match the observed customs HS 82071900 (rock drilling/DTH bits) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS should be corrected to the factual 82071900 (rock-drilling tools) with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: this is the Indian arm of the Swedish Epiroc group (own manufacturing/assembly plus distribution), so manufacturer_trader is the plausible role, but that is inference, not verified here. PAN AAECE7216R appears in the ImportKey supplier block ('AAECE7216R, TD (C/O GEODIS LOGISTICS)') which is consistent with the claimed PAN, though the block is a counterparty listing and not a registry check. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources read; no figures invented. Bottom line on rule 5: no export shipment trail found for this entity in the free sources; inbound import records are confirmed and dated, domestic supply is unverified — 'следов экспортных поставок не найдено'.
